verdicts.reason: A keeps the photo/quote split and spaces the G.M. ALLEN box comfortably under the quote. However, the top quote-mark glyph is blown up to a huge size that clashes with the tiny bottom glyph, and it is crammed against the photo's left edge. B has the same oversized, mismatched quote marks. It also pushes the quote text tight against the photo and enlarges the author box until its letterspaced name competes with the quote. That box sits almost touching the last quote line and shows a visible break in its bottom border.
